post.summary: Ask Kavita to rescan its libraries (admin)
post.description: Manual only: no rename or metadata write triggers a scan, so a session of many small edits costs one scan instead of one per edit. SCOPE: the scan is targeted. librarr lists Kavita's libraries, translates each library's folders back to local paths through KAVITA_PATH_MAP, and scans those that overlap the requested root (in either direction — a Kavita library may sit under the root or contain it). Libraries are never matched by name. Several libraries can match one root and all of them are scanned; when none match, the request fails with 409 and a detail naming the local root and the Kavita paths compared.

400.description: Invalid JSON body or missing root

409.description: No Kavita library maps to this root; detail names the local root and the Kavita paths compared

502.description: Kavita refused or could not be reached; detail carries Kavita's HTTP status and reason, never an internal URL or token

503.description: Kavita is not configured, or no library directory is configured

get.summary: List one directory of one library — a single non-recursive ReadDir (admin)
get.description: Cached in memory for ~30s and invalidated for any folder librarr writes to. No archive is opened: metadata is read on demand through /api/files/metadata.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path of a directory under a library root

editable.description: librarr can write metadata into it (CBZ and EPUB only)

400.description: Path missing, relative, or not a directory

post.summary: Move the files of several sibling folders into one series folder (admin)
post.description: Same payload as /api/files/merge/preview, recomputed server-side. Only rows whose status is "move" are applied: a collision or a name already taken in the target is never overwritten. The target folder is created if missing, with no hard-coded mode so the umask decides. A source folder is removed only when os.Remove succeeds on it, i.e. only when it is empty — never recursively; one that survives is reported with what it still holds, hidden entries (@eaDir, dotfiles) included, since those are exactly why a folder that looked empty in the listing refuses to go.

200.description: Result; per-file failures are collected rather than aborting the batch

path.description: The target folder, to reopen the listing on

skipped.description: Rows that were not applied, with the same status keys as the preview

remaining.description: Up to 20 entry names, hidden ones included

403.description: A path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

404.description: One of the folders was not found

500.description: The target folder could not be created

post.summary: Show what merging several volume folders into one series folder would do (admin)
post.description: Torrents produce one folder per volume, Kavita wants one folder per series. Distinct from /api/files/rename/*, which still refuses an existing target folder. Constraints: at least two folders, all sharing the same parent (scattered folders are refused), only their direct files move, subfolders stay where they are. The target is <parent>/<sanitized series name>, which may already exist or be one of the selected folders. volumes is keyed by "<source folder name>/<file name>" because two volume folders often hold identically named files.

200.description: One row per file of every selected folder, with the target name and a status key

subfolders.description: Left where they are; a folder holding one is never removed

400.description: Invalid JSON body, missing series name, fewer than two folders, more than 100 folders, the same folder twice, folders that are not siblings, a path that is not a folder, or more than 2000 files

403.description: A path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

404.description: One of the folders was not found

get.summary: Read the metadata one file currently holds (admin)
get.description: Opens the archive, so it is meant to be called when a file panel is opened, not for every row of a listing. A non-editable format (PDF, CBR, audio) answers 200 with editable=false and a reason key rather than an error.

reason.description: Present only when editable is false

400.description: Path missing, relative, or path is a directory

post.summary: Write metadata into a file, or into every file of a folder (admin)
post.description: Same payload as /api/files/metadata/preview, recomputed server-side. CBZ get a patched ComicInfo.xml, EPUB a patched OPF; unsupported formats are counted, not failed. A file that fails does not stop the batch — its error is collected.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, no field supplied, or a per-volume field targeted at a directory

403.description: Path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

post.summary: Show what a metadata edit would change, file by file, without writing (admin)
post.description: Values are replaced, not merged (mode append only concerns the list fields), so the preview is what makes the overwrite visible before it happens. title, series_index and isbn identify a single volume and are rejected when path is a directory. At most 500 files are inspected; beyond that truncated is true.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, no field supplied, or a per-volume field (title, series_index, isbn) targeted at a directory

403.description: Path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

post.description: Same payload as /api/files/rename/preview. The plan is always recomputed server-side from the payload — a plan sent by the client is never applied. If the folder itself cannot be moved, its files are still renamed in place.

200.description: Result; per-file failures are collected in errors rather than aborting the batch

path.description: Where the folder now lives, to reopen the listing on

400.description: Invalid JSON body, missing series name, missing or unknown rename mode, or path is not a directory

403.description: Path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

post.summary: Rename a single file to a free-form name (admin)
post.description: The name is sanitized and the original extension is always kept: a typed "Berserk.exe" on a .cbz becomes "Berserk.exe.cbz" rather than a file Kavita can no longer read.

new_name.description: New name, with or without the extension

400.description: Invalid JSON body, empty name, unchanged name, or path is a directory

403.description: Path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

409.description: A file already has the target name

post.summary: Preview the renaming of a folder and its files, without touching anything (admin)
post.description: Every file of the folder is returned, including those that will not move, so nothing is silently left out. A volume number is never guessed: a file with no detected and no supplied number comes back with status no_volume and is skipped.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder, never a bare library root

series_name.description: Target series name; the UI pre-fills it with the current folder name

mode.description: Required: an absent or none mode is refused with 400

volumes.description: Manual volume numbers keyed by the file's current base name; overrides detection

400.description: Invalid JSON body, missing series name, missing or unknown rename mode, or path is not a directory

403.description: Path outside the libraries, or a bare library root

get.summary: List the browsable library roots — MANGA_DIR / EBOOK_DIR / AUDIOBOOK_DIR, keeping only directories that exist (admin)
get.description: Entry point of the /api/files/* surface, which browses the filesystem directly and never queries Kavita. Every other /api/files/* path takes an absolute path that must sit under one of these roots.

kavita.description: Whether POST /api/files/kavita/scan is usable on this instance

get.summary: Get a Kavita series' current metadata (admin; for pre-filling the bulk editor)

post.summary: Bulk-write metadata into the files of the selected Kavita series (EPUB OPF / CBZ ComicInfo.xml), then rescan (admin)

rename.description: Realign folder/file names with the series field being written; requires fields.series

post.summary: Preview the folder/file renames a bulk metadata edit would perform, without touching anything (admin)

get.summary: Search an online metadata source (AniList for manga, Open Library for books) for candidates to pre-fill the bulk editor (admin)
Prowlarr indexer category tree for the advanced search panel (fork)
get.description: Live tree from Prowlarr (GET /api/v1/indexer/categories), cached 24h. live=false means the builtin fallback: the query override still works, only the suggestions are static. Exposes taxonomy IDs and names only, no indexer secrets.

post.summary: Create one empty folder inside a library (admin)
post.description: The name is a single segment sanitized with the same rules as rename; the sanitized name is what is created and returned. The parent may be a library root. The parent listing is invalidated so Browse shows the new folder immediately.

path.description: Absolute path of the parent directory

name.description: New folder name (single segment, sanitized server-side)

400.description: Invalid JSON body, empty/invalid name, or parent is not a directory

409.description: A folder already has that name

post.summary: Repack .cbr or render .pdf as .cbz in place, one or many (admin)
post.description: CBR is repacked with a pure-Go RAR reader; PDF pages are rasterized with poppler pdftoppm (PDF_DPI/PDF_JPEG_QUALITY, defaults 200/90) and the text layer is dropped. Async: validates then answers 202 with a job id; the single background worker converts in FIFO order and the client polls GET /api/files/convert/jobs/{id}. Closing the tab loses nothing.

path.description: Absolute path of the .cbr/.pdf file (single shape)

400.description: Not a convertible file, encrypted, empty, unsafe, or too many pages

409.description: Single shape: a file already has the converted name

200.description: Batch report: what converted and what did not

202.description: Accepted; poll the job until done

post.summary: Move one file or a batch of files into another library folder (admin)
post.description: The file keeps its name; an occupied name is a 409, never an overwrite. Only files can be moved (folders relocate through merge). Both the source and destination listings are invalidated.

path.description: Absolute path of the file (single-file shape)

sources.description: Absolute paths of the files (batch shape, max 500)

dest.description: Absolute path of the destination folder (a library root is allowed)

200.description: Moved (single shape) or per-file report (batch shape)

400.description: Invalid JSON body, source is a folder, dest is not a folder, or already there

409.description: A file already has this name in the destination

200.description: Job with progress; result embedded when done

404.description: Unknown job (never existed, expired, or server restarted)

FileMetadataFields.description: Metadata of one file as read from its ComicInfo.xml (CBZ) or OPF (EPUB). Absent and empty are the same thing here.

FileMetadataRequest.description: Payload shared by /api/files/metadata/preview and /api/files/metadata/apply — applying is 'preview again, then act', not a second code path.

path.description: Absolute path of a file or a folder under a library root

mode.description: Only affects the list fields (authors, genres, tags); scalars are always replaced

fields.description: Only the fields present are written. title, series_index and isbn identify a single volume and are refused when path is a folder.

FolderMergeRequest.description: Payload shared by /api/files/merge/preview and /api/files/merge/apply — applying is 'preview again, then act', not a second code path. The plan is always recomputed server-side.

sources.description: Absolute paths of the folders to merge. They must all share the same parent.

series_name.description: Target series name; sanitized into a single path segment under the shared parent

volumes.description: Volume number per file, keyed by "<source folder name>/<file name>". A value here overrides detection; a file absent from the map falls back to detection, and a file with no volume either way is left where it is.

FolderMergeRow.description: One file of one selected folder. status is a key, not a sentence, so the reason is translatable.

key.description: "<source folder name>/<file name>" — the key to use in volumes

target.description: Target file name inside the series folder

status.description: Only "move" is applied. in_place: already in the target folder under that name. no_volume: nothing supplied and nothing detected, never guessed. collision: several selected files claim that name, so none is moved. exists: a file not part of the move already has that name in the target folder.
